subtasks.title: Admin truncation UI for MAX_MAP_HITS + Live Hits loading indicator
subtasks.approach: On DashboardOverlay: (1) show mapStore.rangeHitsCapped message in adminMode as well as driver; (2) bind dashboard.loading / dashboard.refreshing on the Live Hits card. Do not reintroduce recentHits limit(20). Leave MAX_MAP_HITS=100 unchanged.
subtasks.intended_diffs: DashboardOverlay.vue: remove !adminMode guard from rangeHitsCapped banner (or add admin-visible equivalent); show loading when dashboard.loading; subtle refreshing when dashboard.refreshing. dashboard.js: only touch if a missing flag path is found.

subtasks.title: Measure last_7/15/30 load times vs tiered targets
subtasks.approach: Measure cold+warm wall clock for BirdsEye recentHits + hits for last_7/15/30. Targets: today/last_7 cold p95<1s, last_15<2s, last_30<3s, warm<300ms. Record aggregates only. no-go stops for re-plan.
